findings.title: Credential fields leak non-string secrets in shareable exports
findings.trigger: Persist tool arguments containing authorization: {value: SYNTHETIC_OPAQUE_CREDENTIAL} or password: 123456789, then export as JSON or Markdown. Both secrets survive in final bytes.
findings.classification: Missing essential redaction acceptance in the new recursive sanitizer and Markdown export; existing JSON export also lacked this protection, so not a newly introduced JSON regression.
findings.remediation: Apply credential-field policy before type dispatch, redact the entire value of matching credential fields (including objects/lists/numbers), and add real SessionDB final-byte regressions for JSON/Markdown with publishing stubbed and input immutability asserted.
